keyEvents.text: Goal! Getafe 0, Atletico Madrid 1. Álex Baena (Atletico Madrid) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Julián Alvarez.
Goal! Getafe 0, Atletico Madrid 2. Johnny Cardoso (Atletico Madrid) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Julián Alvarez with a cross following a corner.
Johnny Cardoso (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Getafe. Kiko Femenía replaces Ramón Terrats.
Substitution, Getafe. Martín Satriano replaces Jean Valou.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Lee Kang-In replaces Johnny Cardoso.
Second Half begins Getafe 0, Atletico Madrid 2.
Robin Le Normand (Atletico Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Rodrigo Mendoza replaces Álex Baena.
Substitution, Getafe. Borja Mayoral replaces Iván Azón.
Substitution, Getafe. Mario Martín replaces Francho Serrano.
Djené Dakonam (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Alexander Sørloth replaces Julián Alvarez.
Mario Martín (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Getafe. Davinchi replaces Andrés García because of an injury.
Djené Dakonam (Getafe) is shown the red card.
Goal! Getafe 0, Atletico Madrid 3. Alejandro Grimaldo (Atletico Madrid) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
